task: Draft the opening paragraph of a fictional clinician's referral letter for a patient being sent to a specialist for further evaluation. Do not include a diagnosis, treatment plan, or specific test values. Use only the supplied administrative facts.

facts.text: The fictional referring clinician is Dr. Anita Soren at the fictional Clearwater Family Practice.
The fictional specialist is Dr. Marcus Fenn at Brightvale Diagnostic Centre.
The patient is referred for further evaluation of a symptom pattern described in the attached consultation note.
The referral letter is not a clinical opinion on diagnosis or treatment.

forbidden_additions: A treatment recommendation or medication suggestion.
Specific test values or laboratory results.
preserve: The attribution of clinical detail to the attached consultation note.
The nonclinical, administrative scope of the opening paragraph.
